notes:
{衣服|いふく} is a formal, somewhat literary term for clothing or garments.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {衣服|いふく}: clothing (formal, written)
- ⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧: clothes (the most common everyday word)
- ⟦{衣類|いるい}→衣類：04680_irui⟧: clothing, garments (collective, used in labels and stores)
- ⟦{洋服|ようふく}→洋服：05014_youfuku⟧: Western-style clothes
- ⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧: traditional Japanese clothing (or clothes in general in older usage)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {衣服|いふく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧: to wear clothes
- {衣服|いふく}⟦{費|ひ}→費：09877_hi⟧: clothing expenses

RELATED COMPOUND:
⟦{衣食住|いしょくじゅう}→衣食住：15095_ishokujuu⟧ (clothing, food, shelter) — the three basic necessities of life. This is a set phrase where {衣|い} represents clothing.

REGISTER:
{衣服|いふく} appears in formal writing, academic texts, and official contexts. In everyday conversation, ⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧ is the natural choice.
